name: PLL Rhode Island Overnight Lacrosse Camp 2026
street_address: Roger Williams University, 1 Old Ferry Rd
description_short: A four-day lacrosse camp at Roger Williams University, coached by PLL pros Kyle Jackson and Zach Geddes. You can choose an overnight option with room and board or a day camp option. All skill levels are welcome.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund, minus the transaction processing fee, if you cancel within 72 hours of registering, as long as you registered more than 14 days before the event. After 72 hours there is no refund or credit for any reason, including medical, injury or illness cancellations.
special_needs_notes: The camp says it can help with allergies and specific dietary needs if you contact it by email.
